title: Periodic Ground States in Gross–Pitaevskii Theory
exact_target: Determine whether every infinite-volume Gross--Pitaevskii ground state is crystalline above the fluid--solid transition.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005661 (OWR-14297742-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Many-Body Quantum Systems (2023), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2023/39, pp. 2247--2302. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The quantifier is every ground state, not merely the existence of a periodic minimizer. Infinite-volume ground state and $\mu_c$ use the source definitions.
